# Maggie O'Neill Centre

> The Maggie O'Neill Centre is a charity-run training, meeting and event venue in Huyton, near Liverpool (433 Liverpool Road, L36 8HT), and a virtual office provider. A host meets every group at the door, rooms are set before you arrive, tea and coffee are served in the room, every room has a screen with AirPlay and HDMI, and parking is free. Profits fund Maggie's Meals and community support in Knowsley. Registered charity 1102507.

Key facts:
- Phone 0151 482 0408. Text or WhatsApp 07426 935661.
- Open Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5pm. Evening and weekend room hire on request.
- Free car park on site, 30 seconds from the M57, on a main bus route.
- 230 Google reviews (September 2026). In the last year: 900+ rooms hired, 150+ businesses served, 750+ people accessed Maggie's Meals.
- Used by care providers, the NHS and primary care networks, Knowsley Council, schools, and fostering and adoption teams (Adoption in Merseyside, Knowsley Fostering, Foster4).
- Virtual office plans: £20, £30, £40 and £50 a month. Call answering add-on £39 a month.
- Book or check availability: https://maggieoneill.officernd.com/public/calendar

## Rooms and venue hire
- [Training rooms](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/training-rooms/): hosted training rooms near Liverpool, layouts, capacities and what's included
- [Oliver McGowan training venue](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/training-rooms/oliver-mcgowan-training-venue/): accessible Auditorium for Tier 2 days, up to 60 cabaret with wheelchair space, adjustable lighting, a quiet room, and accessible parking outside
- [Care training venue](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/training-rooms/care-training-venue/): mandatory training for support workers (TMVA, safety intervention, hoist, medication, first aid)
- [Fostering and adoption training venue](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/training-rooms/fostering-adoption-training-venue/): calm rooms for preparation courses, with every borough welcome
- [NHS training venue](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/training-rooms/nhs-training-venue/): clinical and admin training days and monthly meetings
- [Councils, schools and public sector](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/training-rooms/council-training-venue/): training, INSET days and social value
- [Meeting rooms](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/meeting-rooms/): from the Pod (boardroom for 4, £20 an hour or £120 a day) upwards
- [Events and conferences](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/event-space-business-and-community/): the Auditorium
- [What's included](https://mobtc.co.uk/whats-included/)

## Virtual office
- [Virtual office near Liverpool](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/virtual-office/): registered office, director's service address, business address and mail handling, from £20 a month
- [Call answering](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/virtual-office/call-answering/): £39 a month. Calls answered, messages taken, put through or summarised and sent to you
- [For accountants](https://mobtc.co.uk/services/virtual-office/accountants/): 15% off for referred clients and one login for all client post
